'''Head Clerk''' is the title of the [[Ajah Heads|Head]] of the [[Gray Ajah]].

==Title holders==
During the [[White Tower Schism]], [[Serancha Colvine]], who had served in the post before the split, remained as Head Clerk in the [[White Tower|Tower]]. It is unknown who among the rebels held the office, but it is likely Serancha retained it after reunification.
